name: Malign Fury
body:
You relish the terrifying power of your rages, and the devastation they permit you to unleash.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage or rage class feature, smite good class feature, antipaladin level 5th.

Benefit(s): Your antipaladin levels stack with levels in one class that grants bloodrage or rage, for the purpose of determining when you gain rage powers or bloodline powers. Also, your levels in the raging class stack with levels of antipaladin when determining the effects of your smite.

Special: If you have the malevolent shot or malevolent strike class features, or a smite ability that replaces smite good, you can select this feat and apply this benefit to that ability instead.
